title: Kubernetes Specialist
description: Deep Kubernetes operations: run a cluster you built yourself, then secure it, package it, deliver to it and observe it.
descriptionAr: تشغيل Kubernetes بعمق: شغّل كلاستر بنيته بنفسك، ثم أمّنه وحزّمه وانشر عليه وراقبه.

productionProject.title: Self-managed Kubernetes cluster on AWS
productionProject.titleAr: كلاستر Kubernetes ذاتي الإدارة على AWS
productionProject.summary: A kubeadm-provisioned cluster on AWS with Calico networking, default-deny network policies, Helm-packaged workloads, Argo CD reconciliation and a Prometheus stack. Multi-control-plane HA is listed under what this path does not yet teach.

contentGaps: Multi-control-plane HA: the control-plane endpoint, etcd quorum and failure behaviour — required before this path can claim to teach HA

Gateway API: service networking → Ingress → Ingress controllers → Gateway, HTTPRoute and GatewayClass → migrating from Ingress. The Ingress API is frozen upstream, so Gateway is the direction, but it is only worth adding as that full progression
Workloads in depth: DaemonSets, StatefulSets, Jobs and CronJobs
Configuration & storage: ConfigMaps, Secrets, PV/PVC, StorageClasses
Scheduling: taints, tolerations, affinity, requests and limits
RBAC, ServiceAccounts, Pod Security Standards and admission control
